Track Written, Composed, Produced and Performed by Ritviz. Available on all streaming platforms!
We hope you’re all safe and sound. As a team, we put in a lot of effort for every single music video we release. But this one was really special for all of us, because all of you made it possible. This time, you guys were the crew & the talent, turning your homes into our set. The hundreds of videos you all sent from across the globe, showing us that nothing can stop you from doing what moves you, not even the lockdown, is what makes this video extraordinary.
